book.name: Maliki
book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Yesu kangulongela kya ngachangwo ya Kitutubhi kya Chapanga
Yesu pakabheghite mu kuhuma ku Kitutubhi kya Chapanga, yumoo ywa ahundwa bhake kakinng'ombela, “Nhunda, ghulole huti maganga agha mughabheghiti makulu na hitutubhi ahi muhinnyelembekite.”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Ghuhibhona hitutubhi ahi muhibheghite ngulu? Kahone hata liganga limo lya kulonda kuhighala unani mwa liganga lingi, ghoha ghatahangulighwa.”
Kupungwa na himbamanda
Yesu pakatamite ku Kitumbi kya Mizeituni paakilola Kitutubhi kya Chapanga Petili na Yakobu na Yohana na Andelea bhakinkonya mu lupwepo,
“Chonde, ghutughombele mihalu ayi yabhegha pakiki, na naho yake yabhegha bhuli payiheghelela kubwitukila?”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mulindakile, mundu ywoheli kakotoke kuakuluha.
Kiyaha ayoloho bhaahika kukambuka kwa lihina lyangu, paalongela, ‘Nenga ndo Kilisto’ nabho bhataahokeha bhandu ayoloho.
Pannyihwa kyobho ya mikoha paugheghela ebu mihalo ya mikoha kya kutali, nkotoo kubhegha na bhwagalili. Mihalu ayi mbaka yihumbuke peni uhiko ghwake ukali hela.

Mana bhandu bha nnima ghumo ghwatutana na bhandu bha nnima ghungi; na ghubhutwa ghwatutana na ghubhutwa ghungi. Kwabhegha na migwangwaliko mbande nhanganganiko lung'ahi lwa njala. Mihalu aywo yingulihwana na lihingila lya ulongohi.”

“Peni mwenga mulindakile, mana bhatabhakokela mu njengakaya, na kuatuta mu Hitutubhi ya kukonganila Akaayahudi; bhatabhayegha hilongohi na akaabhutwa kwa mihalo ya nenga ngati mubhaghombele Nhalo ghwa Maha.
Peni mbaka Mihalo ya Maha yilandamihwe huti kwa bhandu bha milima hyoha kukali na kuhika ghula uhiko.

Nabho paabhakamula na kubhakokela mu njengakaya, nkotoo kubhegha na bhwaghalili ya kya kulongela; Uhiko pauhika, nnongele kyohele kya kya mukamuhitwe ngati mwenga ng'obhe munpala kulongela ngati Nhuki ghwa Chapanga.
Nnongo katankiluka nnongo ghwake ngati kakakomwe, na tate katankiluka mwana ghwake. Bhana bhataakiluka tate na ma ghwabhe na kuakoma.
Bhandu bhoha bhataakalalila mwenga kwa kya nenga. Peni yunakulimbilila kunhyubhalila mbaka kuuhiko katalopoka.”
Lung'ahe lukulu
“Pamulibhona ‘Kilibhi kinakunnyaghabhiha Chapanga’ kiyima pautamiho ghwake ng'obhe, yunakusoma kamanyeghe nhalo aghu, hino bhala bhaabheghite ku Yudea bhatughile ku hitumbi.
Ywakabheghite kulinyakaha ya kitutubhi kakotoho kuhuluka kuyingila munyumba kati mwaki kakatole kilibhi.
Naywo ywakabheghite kunng'unda kakotoo kubhuya ukaya kutola kyoheli.
Peni kibhabhone bhombe bhana ndumbo na bhanakuyongeha bhana masiku agho!
Nnyupe kwa Chapanga ngati mihalo ayi yikotoo kubwitukila pakipepo.
Mana mumasiku agho lutabhegha lung'ahe lukulu lwa nga kubhonekana, tangu ulongohi pala Chapanga pakabhumbite nnima mbaka lelo. Na kubhegha kangi ng'obhe mumasiku gha pala kuhika.
Handa Bambo kangahupitahiti ng'obhe masiku agho, Kahone kulopoka mundu ywohele. Peni kwa kya bhandu ahaghulwa, bhakabhahaghulite, kaghahupia masiku agho.”
“Hinu mundu ywohele pakaaghombela, ‘Nnole, Kilisto ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga kabhegha apa!’ Ebu, ‘Kabhegha kula’ mangahyubhalila.
Mana bha bwitukila akina kilisto bhanga kuhaghulwa na Chapanga na mambuye bha uhwangi. Nabho bhatatenda naho na mihabho ngati bhabhahokehe ahaghulwa bha Chapanga.
Peni mwenga mulindakile, nenga niabhaghombela ghoha ghakali na kubwitukila.”
Kuhika kwa Mwana ghwa Mundu
“Peni mumasiku agho, mbole ya lung'ahe alwo, luchubha lwayingihwa lubhindo, na lubhalamwehi kabhone kumulika,
ndondwa hyaponeka kuhuma kunani na makakala gha kunani pamahundi ghatayukana.
Ndo bhandu bhatammona Mwana ghwa Mundu pakihika mumahundi kwa makakala mayoloho na ukulu.
Mbole katabhalaghiha andumitumi ghwake ghwa kuluhingu abhakwemukihe bhandu ahaghulwa bhake kuhuma mumbande hyoha ya nnima kuyandila kuuhiko ghwa n'nima mbaka kuuhiko ghwa luhingu.”
Lihundo lya kya Ntini
“Mughulole nkongo ghwa ntini na mulihunde ndambulo ayi; kamu pa mubhabhona mapanyo ghake paghatomola mahamba mmanye kukita pamabeno paheghela
Ubhwabhu abhu, pamuyibhona mihalu ayi payitendeka, mmanye kukita Kilisto ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga kabha ugheghela mwa nlyango!
Kulyaghila nungubhaghombela, kibheleko aki kyapitingana ng'obhe mbaka mihalu ayi hyoha yibwituke.
Luhingu na nnima hyapitingana, peni malagho ghangu kahone kupita kata.”
Kahone yunakumanya lisiku ebu lisaa
“Peni kwa mihalo ya lisiku lila na lisaa kahone ywa kumanya, hata andumitumi ghwa kuluhingu ghwa Chapanga, ebu Mwana, maha nga Tate ghweka chake ndo yunakumanya.
Mulindakile, mmeghe kala, kiyaha mmanya ng'obhe lisaa alyo lya hika pakiki.

Yabhegha handa mundu ywakabheghite mumwanja ywakabhalekiti andumitumi bhalulolekehe maha alwo lubhagha lwake kila mundu na lihengo lyake, naywo kakinkwilikiha lichonda ghwa ku nlyango ‘Ghukotoo kughonja.’
Hinu mbheghe kala mana, mmanya ng'obhe mabhuyo gha nkola lubhagha, kukita makimuhi, ebu pakilu pa pakati, ebu pangeha ya kubhika njogolo, ebu malabhila pakuchegha.
Handa pakabhuya kwa kinunu kabhayitukite nng'onja.
Na ali linibhaghombela mwenga, nungubhaghombela bhoha, mmbheghe kala!”
